rules.expected: Candidate generation, candidate identities, optimization outcomes, deduplication, validation, and stopping/coverage are all documented at candidate level.
Every advanced candidate has an explicit stationary-point validation record, and only candidates reported as local minima are counted as validated minima.
The completed result reports three distinct validated minima; bounded failure may report a smaller explored count only with truthful limitations.

For a completed investigation, the conclusion identifies a strongest validated candidate from a consistent interaction-energy convention and distinguishes independent calculations from the source-reported −36.59 kJ/mol value; for bounded failure it explicitly limits the result and does not claim a strongest candidate.
The report is auditable within its declared search scope.
The final conclusion supports gas-phase hydrogen-bonded association from validated minima and explicitly limits extrapolation to solution, solid, or device behavior.
